faq.q: What is Crest in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Crest, also called Crest Kayaks, is a fictional outdoor-equipment brand identified in an official GTA 6 screenshot and a postcard-style promotional video.

faq.q: Where does Crest appear in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is associated with Mount Kalaga National Park, identified by community wiki sources in an official screenshot and a promotional video on Rockstar's promotional site.

faq.q: Is Crest based on a real kayak brand?
faq.a: Its name and logo style closely mirror the real-world kayak manufacturer Crescent Kayaks, continuing the series' pattern of lightly disguised real-brand parodies for outdoor equipment.

faq.q: Can players buy or rent Crest kayaks in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. The record only confirms the brand's appearance in promotional imagery, not any in-game purchase, rental, or usable mechanic.

faq.q: Who identified the Crest brand in GTA 6 material?
faq.a: Community wiki sources spotted it in official promotional material rather than Rockstar naming it directly, so it is filed here as community-identified.
